Changes.note: “Köşk destesi aç” opens a deck in your name; it is not public, and every talebe enrolled in (or done with) a published, shown course of the köşk reads it, studies it and adds it to their collection. Only the nazım who opened it writes its cards; the köşk’s other nazımları cannot open its card table. Opened from a proposal, the proposal is accepted with the deck; the proposer is not notified of it. “Reddet” sends the reason to the proposer’s notifications. “Gizle” moves the deck to the köşk’s archive and takes it from the talebe; nothing is deleted and it can be brought back from the archive. A deck that was published stays in the public reads even when hidden. A change in the card table reaches the talebe at once.
